items.html: And with this you will understand the verse “Blessings upon the head of the righteous” (Proverbs 10:6), mentioned in the Zohar, portion Vayetze, page 162. And the matter is that these two Atrin [crowns], when they descend here below into the two crowns of AVI, whose place is between the two thighs — and in their thighs they are called Berachot [blessings], in the language of knees — and these knees and the blessings are upon the head of the righteous, for the righteous is the Yesod, and the head of the righteous is the crown within it, called the head of the Yesod, and there is their place. Also with this you will understand how afterwards, at the time of the coupling, ZA gives the Nukva the five Gevurot and afterwards the five Hassadim, for all of them are the phase of Malchut.
